title: For Such a Time as This
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses to wonder before she acts, and tonight Mordecai asks Esther to wonder why she is queen: Wren stops when her little brother cannot reach his cup, wonders if that is why she is his big sister, and helps him right where she is.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she pauses to wonder about the important things. In Wren’s world today: Wren noticed her little brother couldn’t reach his cup and was about to cry. She stopped and thought, “I’m big enough to help — maybe that’s why I’m his big sister.” She handed him the cup with a smile. Just like Esther wondered about her purpose, Wren wondered how Heavenly Father could use her, right where she was.
